annotations.topic: FY25 Audited Results & Fitch Outlook Revised to Stable
annotations.note: FY25 rev TRY 12.92bn, EBITDA TRY 4.99bn ($114m), FFO net lev 5.1x; YEKDEM cliff to 27% in 2026; $550m green bond refi completed.
Fitch revised Aydem Renewables Outlook to Stable (affirmed B) in 2026; tracking YEKDEM-to-merchant power transition and 4.7x-5.1x FFO net leverage.
Revenues secured by long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) or regulated tariff frameworks, providing hard-currency indexation and guaranteed minimum volume off-take.
Heavy generation transition capex peaks in 2024-2025; multi-year FCF inflects strongly positive as commercial operations commence.
Strategic national utility champions benefit from government balancing accounts or explicit fuel supply guarantees, mitigating commodity price volatility.
9M26 rev TRY 12.10bn, net profit TRY 5.24bn (deferred tax boost); servicing $550m late-2025 green Eurobond ($27.16m coupon paid spring-26).

verdict.stance: Underweight / Merchant Exposure & Hydrology Drag (B Stable Fitch)
verdict.summary: Fitch affirmed Aydem Renewables at B (Outlook revised to Stable from Positive) after weak hydrology and softer spot prices pushed 2025 EBITDA to $114m and FFO net leverage to 5.1x. While late-2025 $550m green bond refinancing removed 2027 maturity risk, YEKDEM FiT share drops from 51% (2025) to 27% (2026) and 11% (2027-28).

positives: Refinancing cliff cleared via late-2025 $550m green Eurobond; spring-26 $27.16m coupon paid on schedule.
100% renewable hydro/wind/geothermal generation asset base with partial USD-linked YEKDEM tariffs.
Low marginal operating costs once hydrology normalizes.
negatives: Hydrology sensitivity and YEKDEM tariff expirations shifting mix toward merchant spot power.
High leverage (~4.1x) and group-level capex/debt across sister Aydem Energy entities (Adm/Gdz).
Operational gross profit contraction under IAS 29 in 9M26.
